_help: Sponsor a Toy prices (US dollars only) and rules. toyMonth: price for one toy for one calendar month, by toy id; newToy is the price for a toy in its first month. Allowed categories and rules are shown on /advertise/ and checked when you approve a booking.
rules: No token promotions, price claims or "buy now" calls.
Sponsor cards never sit inside gameplay, never block play and never appear on certificates.
Every booking is reviewed before it goes live. If we reject it, you get a full refund.
